+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command,roles_installed,collections_installed,skipped', [
+    (['install'], True, True, None),
+    (['install', '-p', 'custom_roles'], True, False, 'collections cannot be installed to a roles path'),
+    (['role', 'install'], True, False, 'contains collections which will be ignored'),
+    (['role', 'install', '-p', 'custom_roles'], True, False, None),
+    (['collection', 'install'], False, True, 'contains roles which will be ignored'),
+])
+def test_install_mixed_requirements(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, command, roles_installed,
+                                    collections_installed, skipped):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- example.role\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+
+    install_roles = MagicMock()
+    install_collections_mock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', install_roles)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', install_collections_mock)
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', requirements_file]).run()
+
+    assert bool(install_roles.called) is roles_installed
+    assert bool(install_collections_mock.called) is collections_installed
+    if collections_installed and command[0] == 'install':
+        assert install_collections_mock.call_args[0][1] == C.COLLECTIONS_PATHS[0]
+    output = capsys.readouterr()
+    if skipped:
+        assert skipped.lower() in ' '.join((output.out + output.err).lower().split())
+    if command[:2] == ['role', 'install'] and '-p' in command:
+        assert 'contains collections which will be ignored' not in output.out + output.err
+    if roles_installed:
+        assert 'Starting galaxy role install process' in output.out
+
+
+def test_install_empty_requirements(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    requirements_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(requirements_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles: []\ncollections: []\n')
+    install_collections_mock = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', install_collections_mock)
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', requirements_file]).run()
+    assert not install_collections_mock.called
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
